What I'm trying to say is, don't upvote it just because it's disturbing

From my understanding, one upvotes based on whether or not they enjoy the article/whether they believe it has merit, reasons for doing so being what they are. If one is intrigued by the disturbing factor (whether it makes them inherently aware of an aspect of the world they had not at first considered, or it just simply seems out of the ordinary), then they should feel free to upvote because of that.

upvote it because there's something interesting or unique (or freaky) about it that requires it to be contained by the SCP Foundation

Just my two cents, but I'm iffy on that statement. Technically, there are quite a few items that the Foundation doesn't possess an overwhelming need to contain. For example, might I suggest looking at SCP-348? Which brings me to your comment,

the point of that bit (that really turned me off to this SCP) is that it's not anomalous in its composition.

SCP-348 is just ceramic, and give or take the scenario, with soup.

Also, Dexa's a mod. I have a feeling he knows what he's doing.

As such, please don't feel like I'm calling you out. You're free to express your own thoughts, and these just happen to be my own. Taste varies from person to person, after all.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
No offense, but…the point of that bit (that really turned me off to this SCP) is that it's not anomalous in its composition. SCP's aren't horrifying or freaky by definition, they just usually are because of the common base fear of the unknown (and a lot of them kill people) - things that can be explained my modern science, such as a composition of asbestos and fiberglass, make it not an SCP, though it still is kind of disturbing. Disturbing ≠ SCP, but SCP often = disturbing.

What I'm trying to say is, don't upvote it just because it's disturbing - upvote it because there's something interesting or unique (or freaky) about it that requires it to be contained by the SCP Foundation…which there isn't, in my opinion - the only thing that makes it containment-worthy is the compulsion thing, and honestly, that's severely overdone.
